dialogues.title: В малой группе: уточнить и обосновать
dialogues.prompt: You missed question five. Ask your partner to read the clue aloud and then ask where you can find the answer.
dialogues.answer: Could you read the clue out loud, please? Could you tell me where we can find the answer?

phrases.phrase: Could you read the clue out loud?
phrases.meaning: Можешь прочитать подсказку вслух?
phrases.pattern: Could you + глагол — вежливая просьба.
phrases.example: Could you read the last sentence out loud?

phrases.phrase: Could you read it word for word?
phrases.meaning: Можешь прочитать это слово в слово?
phrases.pattern: Word for word — дословно, без пересказа.
phrases.example: Could you repeat the instructions word for word?

role.line: I can see the clue for question five. Do you need any help?

dialogues.title: Договорись, кто за кем заедет
dialogues.prompt: Ask politely whether your partner can pick you up, then find out what time they plan to leave.
dialogues.answer: Would you mind picking me up at my mum’s? Could you tell me what time you’re planning to leave?

phrases.phrase: Could you pick me up on the way?
phrases.meaning: Можешь заехать за мной по дороге?
phrases.pattern: Pick someone up — заехать за кем-то, забрать.
phrases.example: Could you pick me up on your way to the station?

phrases.phrase: Have you worked out how you’re getting there?
phrases.meaning: Ты уже решил, как туда доберёшься?
phrases.pattern: Work out how + подлежащее + глагол — разобраться, как что-то сделать.
phrases.example: Have you worked out how you’re getting to the airport?

role.line: I’m driving past your area, but I haven’t decided when to leave.

dialogues.title: Попроси преподавателя о конкретной обратной связи
dialogues.prompt: Ask the tutor to point out one specific mistake and give you a chance to say it again.
dialogues.answer: Could you point out one thing I could say more naturally? Would it be all right if I tried again?

phrases.phrase: Could you give me a more natural phrase and let me try again?
phrases.meaning: Можешь предложить более естественную фразу и дать мне попробовать ещё раз?
phrases.pattern: Let me + глагол без to.
phrases.example: Could you suggest a clearer opening and let me try again?

phrases.phrase: Could you be more specific about the speaking goal?
phrases.meaning: Можешь точнее сформулировать цель по устной речи?
phrases.pattern: Be more specific about + тема, которую нужно уточнить.
phrases.example: Could you be more specific about the problem?

role.line: You explained your point well, but one part sounded a little unnatural.

dialogues.school: ACE TEFL (предположительно; в записи не подтверждено)
dialogues.title: В аптеке: описать предмет по функции
dialogues.prompt: You cannot remember the name of a plaster. Describe its purpose and politely check that the pharmacist understands.
dialogues.answer: I don’t know the word, but it’s a small sticky strip you put over a cut. Does that make sense?

role.line: What exactly are you looking for?

phrases.phrase: Does that make sense?
phrases.meaning: Это понятно?
phrases.pattern: Does + that + make sense? — обязательно подлежащее, тон зависит от ситуации.
phrases.example: I mean the small sticky strip. Does that make sense?

dialogues.title: Уточнить задание и отправку
dialogues.prompt: Clarify the size of the writing task and check who should receive it.
dialogues.answer: Could you clarify whether you want four opening sentences or a full report? Should I send them only to the first teacher?

role.line: Please write the opening sentences and email them after class.

phrases.phrase: Could you clarify whether you want four opening sentences or a full report?
phrases.meaning: Можешь уточнить: нужны четыре начальных предложения или полный отчёт?
phrases.pattern: Could you clarify whether + subject + verb — уточнить выбор между двумя вариантами.
phrases.example: Could you clarify whether you want a summary or the full text?

dialogues.title: Уточнить ссылку и ингредиенты
dialogues.prompt: You can see your partner’s screen but need the recipe link. Ask for it, then ask about a vegetarian adaptation.
dialogues.answer: Could you share the web link in the chat, please? Could I adapt this recipe with tofu?

role.line: I’m already sharing the recipe on my screen. What else do you need?

phrases.phrase: Could you share the web link in the chat, please?
phrases.meaning: Можете отправить ссылку на страницу в чат?
phrases.pattern: Could you + base verb; share the link уточняет цель просьбы.
phrases.example: Could you share the recipe link in the chat, please?

phrases.phrase: Could I adapt this recipe with tofu?
phrases.meaning: Могу я изменить этот рецепт, используя тофу?
phrases.pattern: Could I + base verb — вежливый вопрос о возможности.
phrases.example: Could I adapt this recipe for vegetarian guests?

dialogues.title: Комплимент фотографии и ответ
dialogues.prompt: Ask to see your partner’s photo. Give a specific compliment, then respond gratefully to a compliment on your own work.
dialogues.answer: Could I have a look at your photo? I love the way you caught the light. Thank you, I really appreciate it.

role.line: Here is my latest photo. I also think your picture looks lovely.

phrases.phrase: Could I have a look at your photo?
phrases.meaning: Можно взглянуть на твою фотографию?
phrases.pattern: Could I + base verb — вежливое разрешение.
phrases.example: Could I have a look at your latest picture?

phrases.phrase: Thank you, I really appreciate it.
phrases.meaning: Спасибо, мне очень приятно.
phrases.pattern: Appreciate + object, не обязательное for.
phrases.example: Thank you, I really appreciate your feedback.

dialogues.title: Четыре формы будущего
dialogues.prompt: Make plans for a play. Give a timetable, an arrangement, an earlier intention and an offer you make during the conversation.
dialogues.answer: The performance starts at seven. I’m meeting Alex outside the theatre at six. I’m going to book the tickets tonight. Do you need a lift? I’ll pick you up.

phrases.phrase: The performance starts at seven.
phrases.meaning: Спектакль начинается в семь.
phrases.pattern: Present Simple — время по расписанию.
phrases.example: The workshop starts at nine.

phrases.phrase: I’m meeting my friend at the theatre on Friday.
phrases.meaning: В пятницу я встречаюсь с другом у театра.
phrases.pattern: Present Continuous — уже есть договорённость.
phrases.example: I’m meeting my conversation partner on Tuesday.

role.line: I’d love to see the play on Friday. What’s the plan?

dialogues.title: Экодом и полезные технологии
dialogues.prompt: Continue the dialogue with your plans for an eco-house. Say what you’ve already decided, what you’ve arranged for Friday and what you can offer to do now.
dialogues.answer: We’re going to improve the insulation first. A technician is coming to check the smart meter on Friday. I’ll send you the energy readings now.

phrases.phrase: We’re going to improve the insulation first.
phrases.meaning: Сначала мы собираемся улучшить теплоизоляцию.
phrases.pattern: Going to — намерение, которое уже сформировалось.
phrases.example: We’re going to replace the windows next month.

phrases.phrase: A technician is coming to check the smart meter on Friday.
phrases.meaning: В пятницу придёт мастер проверить умный счётчик.
phrases.pattern: Present Continuous + день — договорённость о визите.
phrases.example: A plumber is coming to fix the shower on Monday.

role.line: We need to get the house ready for winter. What have you planned so far?

dialogues.title: Мои занятия и цели в английском
dialogues.prompt: Tell your tutor how you’ll practise next week. Include a prior intention, a booked session and a decision you make while speaking.
dialogues.answer: I’m going to practise writing clearer emails. I’m meeting my conversation partner on Tuesday. Actually, I’ll write a short draft tonight.

phrases.phrase: Where will you use your English outside class?
phrases.meaning: Где ты будешь использовать английский вне занятий?
phrases.pattern: Will + начальная форма глагола — вопрос о будущем.
phrases.example: Where will you use these phrases at work?

phrases.phrase: I’d also like to write concise emails that sound natural to international colleagues.
phrases.meaning: Я также хотел бы писать короткие письма, которые звучат естественно для иностранных коллег.
phrases.pattern: I’d like to + глагол — что хочется делать или чему хочется научиться.
phrases.example: I’d like to give shorter updates during meetings.

role.line: How are you planning to work on your English next week?

dialogues.title: Объяснить Simple и Continuous
dialogues.prompt: Explain what you will be doing at nine tomorrow and contrast it with what you will have finished by ten.
dialogues.answer: At nine I’ll be reading. By ten I’ll have finished.

role.line: Will the activity be in progress at nine?

phrases.phrase: At nine I’ll be reading; by ten I’ll have finished.
phrases.meaning: В девять буду читать; к десяти закончу.
phrases.pattern: At + момент: will be -ing; by + срок: will have + причастие.
phrases.example: At six I’ll be working; by seven I’ll have finished.

dialogues.title: День без телефона
dialogues.prompt: Make a realistic plan for one morning without your phone. State an intention and agree where to meet.
dialogues.answer: We’re going to spend the morning outside. We’ll meet at the park at ten.

role.line: We have talked about the past, but what will we actually do on our day offline?

phrases.phrase: We’re going to spend the morning outside.
phrases.meaning: Мы собираемся провести утро на улице.
phrases.pattern: Be going to + base verb — намерение; spend time + место/занятие.
phrases.example: We’re going to spend the afternoon together without our phones.

dialogues.title: ИИ и конкретная цель изучения языка
dialogues.prompt: Explain one concrete goal for your English and how you will practise for it. Mention how you use AI without treating every answer as correct.
dialogues.answer: I want to create a podcast in English. I’m going to practise answering spontaneously.

role.line: What would you like to do when you can use English more confidently?

phrases.phrase: I want to create a podcast in English.
phrases.meaning: Я хочу создать подкаст на английском.
phrases.pattern: Want to + base verb; in English для языка.
phrases.example: I want to host interviews in English.

phrases.phrase: I’m going to practise answering spontaneously.
phrases.meaning: Я собираюсь тренировать спонтанные ответы.
phrases.pattern: Be going to + verb; practise + -ing.
phrases.example: I’m going to practise asking follow-up questions.

dialogues.title: Фильм, мнение и вежливое несогласие
dialogues.prompt: Your partner loved the ending. Acknowledge their opinion, disagree gently and give one specific reason.
dialogues.answer: I see what you mean. The twist was surprising, but it felt rushed to me because the characters barely had time to react.

phrases.phrase: I see what you mean.
phrases.meaning: Понимаю, что ты имеешь в виду.
phrases.pattern: Покажи, что понял логику человека, и затем назови свою оговорку.
phrases.example: I see what you mean, but I found the ending confusing.

phrases.phrase: My reservation is that the final twist felt underdeveloped.
phrases.meaning: Меня смущает, что финальный поворот показался недоработанным.
phrases.pattern: My reservation is that + предложение — сдержанное возражение.
phrases.example: My reservation is that the schedule leaves us very little time.

role.line: I honestly thought the ending was perfect. What did you think?

dialogues.title: Экодом и полезные технологии
dialogues.prompt: Your partner wants to install underfloor heating first. Acknowledge the idea, then argue for another priority and explain why.
dialogues.answer: I can see why you’d choose underfloor heating. I’d start with insulation, though. The house loses a lot of heat through the walls.

phrases.phrase: It depends on the building.
phrases.meaning: Это зависит от здания.
phrases.pattern: It depends on + фактор, который влияет на решение.
phrases.example: It depends on how much heat the house loses.

phrases.phrase: Changing the thermostat and reducing heat loss might be more practical.
phrases.meaning: Заменить термостат и снизить потери тепла, возможно, практичнее.
phrases.pattern: Might be more practical — предложить альтернативу без категоричности.
phrases.example: Taking the train might be more practical during rush hour.

role.line: I think we should put in underfloor heating before we do anything else.

dialogues.title: Договорись, кто за кем заедет
dialogues.prompt: Your partner wants to drive at peak time. Acknowledge their point, then politely suggest taking the train or leaving earlier.
dialogues.answer: I see why driving would be easier with Sam. I’m not sure about leaving that late, though. Would it work if we left half an hour earlier?

phrases.phrase: I’m not sure about leaving that late, though.
phrases.meaning: Но я сомневаюсь, стоит ли выезжать так поздно.
phrases.pattern: I’m not sure about + -ing — мягко озвучить сомнение.
phrases.example: I’m not sure about booking that early, though.

phrases.phrase: Would it work if we left half an hour earlier?
phrases.meaning: Получится, если мы выедем на полчаса раньше?
phrases.pattern: Would it work if we + Past Simple — предложить вариант и проверить, подходит ли он.
phrases.example: Would it work if we moved the lesson to Friday?

role.line: Let’s drive. Leaving at five should give us enough time.

dialogues.title: Уточнить позицию и не согласиться
dialogues.prompt: Your partner thinks you support expulsion. Clarify that you are exploring a hypothetical, then explain your concern.
dialogues.answer: I’m not arguing for expulsion; I’m asking how to respond to that view. It could have lasting consequences for a first mistake.

phrases.phrase: I’m not arguing for expulsion; I’m asking how to respond to that view.
phrases.meaning: Я не выступаю за исключение; спрашиваю, как ответить на такую позицию.
phrases.pattern: I’m not arguing for X; I’m asking how… — различить позицию и вопрос.
phrases.example: I’m not arguing for cancellation; I’m asking how we could change the plan.

dialogues.title: Согласовать научную награду
dialogues.prompt: Your partner prefers a different scientist for an award. Recognise their point, explain your choice and suggest one shared criterion.
dialogues.answer: I see your point, but I would choose a different candidate. Could we agree on one criterion first?

role.line: I would choose a different scientist. How can we agree on one winner?

phrases.phrase: I see your point, but I would choose a different candidate.
phrases.meaning: Понимаю твою мысль, но я бы выбрал другого кандидата.
phrases.pattern: I see your point, but + contrasting opinion.
phrases.example: I see your point, but I would give more weight to the impact.

phrases.phrase: Could we agree on one criterion first?
phrases.meaning: Можем сначала договориться об одном критерии?
phrases.pattern: Agree on + noun — согласовать предмет решения.
phrases.example: Could we agree on the criteria before choosing a winner?
